notes.title: Teamfight Manager 2 – Official Development Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Team Samoyed!

We’re excited to share that our next project, Teamfight Manager 2, is currently in development. Not only are we incorporating the extensive feedback we received from the original game, but we also plan to launch it in Early Access to gather even more of your ideas as we refine the experience. Our goal is to let you immerse yourselves in the role of a manager for a longer period, supported by a larger champion roster, additional modes, and deeper tactical and management systems. We’re aiming for an Early Access release at the end of 2025, so stay tuned for more details and be sure to add us to your wishlist!

We truly appreciate all of your support and the feedback you’ve shared with us thus far. Drawing on your enthusiasm, we’ll do our utmost to deliver a vastly improved Teamfight Manager 2 that exceeds your expectations.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009300/

We’ll be posting development diaries from time to time to keep you updated on our progress, so please keep an eye out for those.

Wishing everyone a wonderful new year, and thank you for your continued support!

- Team Samoyed

notes.title: Kitchen Crisis is Officially Released!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Team Samoyed.

As of April 3, 2024, Kitchen Crisis, the follow-up to Teamfight Manager, has been officially released!

Kitchen Crisis is a unique defense game centered around cooking. Efficiently manage your character's movements and wisely choose upgrade builds to serve meals to the invading aliens.

You can experience a special kind of fun different from Teamfight Manager.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118250/Kitchen_Crisis/]Kitchen Crisis Store page[/url]

Additionally, if you already have Teamfight Manager in your library, you can purchase Kitchen Crisis at a discounted price through a bundle.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/39701/_Team_Samoyed_Bundle/

We are grateful to everyone who loves the game and supports our team. Although we cannot respond to each message individually, we read all your feedback and consider it in our development process. We will continue to do our best to create good games.

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.4 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello,
It's Team Samoyed.
Before the 1.4 Patch Note, we would like to inform you that this patch will be our last content update. Furthermore, we would like to explain about some of the changes in the roadmap, which was announced with the launch of the game.
The 1.4 Patch update brings us to an end of the Teamfight Manager development and we intend to start working on a next project. Although there will be no more new contents, if there are any inconveniences in your game experience due to bugs, etc., please contact us at [teamsamoyed@gmail.com] and we will do our best to fix.

[h2]Regarding the Workshop and Trade Market[/h2]

As was announced in the Development Roadmap, we have put a lot of thought into the possibility of implementing the Workshop and Trade Market features. Regrettably, we have come to the following conclusions. In case of the Workshop, difficulty level of implementation has increased significantly due to the introduction of the multiplayer mode with the 1.3 Patch update. In case of the Trade Market, the implementation would lead to a collapse of the game system which was initially designed in a way that was not supposed to utilize IP rights of the real league and players.
As the saying goes, 'A good beginning is half the battle.' To most, the saying encourages them to take up on new challenges and just begin with them. However, for us the saying comes closer to heart with a meaning that decisions made in that good beginning carry a lot of weight. Teamfight Manager was initially developed without the Workshop in mind, which made the implementation of the Workshop later on in the development very difficult. Definitely, a lot of our users anticipated these features and we are positive that these features could have added a whole new level of fun. Nonetheless, it pains us to move on to our next project without being able to implement these features.
As our first game, Teamfight Manager was bound to have its drawbacks. But we hope to make the most out of what we have learned from creating Teamfight Manager and we will do our best to create something better in our next project. We had a ton of fun and enjoyed every bit of the game development, all thanks to Teamfight Manager users who had fun playing the game. We look forward to returning once again, a little bit better and a little bit more fun.

[h2]New contents[/h2]

- New champions added: 5 new champions added.
[list]
[*]     Werewolf
[*]     Taoist
[*]     Mystic Dancer
[*]     Dark Mage
[*]     Cold Corpse
[/list]

- Meta-analysis report feature added. The report will be created in a message box throughout the season, where you can check out mainstream champions, counter champions and combos

- Training report feature added. The report will be created according to players' improvements

- News report feature added. News will be created according to player’s circumstances.

- Gift feature added. You will be able to receive gifts from fans.

- Event Match feature added. You can enjoy special matches that can be played during World Championship period after the end of a regular season. You can build your players by participating in these matches. There are 10 types of event matches and every season you will be able to participate in a match with one of the 3 randomly generated rules.

[olist]
[*]     Accumulated Damage : Team with greater accumulated damage wins.
[*]     Beast Mode : Movement speed of all champions increases by 3. (including Ogre)
[*]     Quick Cast : Cooltime for all champion skills decreases by 80%.
[*]     Jab Jab : ATK of all champions decreases by 50% and ATK speed doubles.
[*]     Solid Blow : ATK speed of all champions decreases by 50% and ATK doubles.
[*]     Iron wall : DEF of all champions increases by 200.
[*]     00 ban : Cannot use 00 champions. (global ban on a specific category / ex. Warrior ban)
[*]     Reverse : Team with fewer kills wins
[*]     Contempt for Weaklings : All champions prioritize their attacks on enemies with low HP.
[*]     Speed Game : Game time: 30 sec, Respawn time: 1 sec
[/olist]

[h2]Changes and improvements[/h2]

- Archer’s Ultimate damage has been decreased.

- Archer’s ATK has been decreased.

- Berserker’s amount of lifesteal has been increased.

- Monk’s recovery coefficient has been increased.

- Monk’s HP has been increased.

- Cook’s ATK speed has been decreased.

- Cook’s skill cooltime has increased.

- Sniper’s ATK speed has been increased.

- Shadowmancer’s Ultimate stat increase amount has been increased.

- Shrine Maiden’s ATK damage and recovery coefficient have been increased.

- Poison Dart Hunter’s skill time has been decreased.

[h2]AI Ban&Pick[/h2]

- The AI on a normal difficulty has been changed to the one prior to the Patch 1.3.2. The new algorithm is applied after the New Game+ on a hard difficulty.

If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to report them to [teamsamoyed@gmail.com].
We will fix them ASAP.

Thank you.

Hello,
It’s Team Samoyed.

We are working on a multiplayer feature, which is a large part of our 1.3 Patch update. There is a lot of room for things to go wrong in the multiplayer mode due to its nature. And it is difficult for our development staff to playtest this feature to a satisfactory extent.

Although the multiplayer feature is a bit unstable, we would still like to present it through Steam Beta-testing and receive feedback to fix bugs. After the Beta-testing, we are planning on officially updating the game (1.3 Patch).

Later on, we will notify when the 1.3 Patch will be officially updated.

Bug reports are most welcome, and you can do so via, [teamsamoyed@gmail.com]

Bugs will be fixed as soon as possible.

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all our Coaches who care about our game and help us improve in our development.

notes.title: Teamfight Manager has been officially released.
notes.notes:
Teamfight Manager is available for purchase and play on Steam. We apologize for the long anticipation.

Since many have given us various opinions and questions through diverse channels, we have summarized a few of our stories for better understanding of the game and who we are.

[h2]Development Background[/h2]

Teamfight Manager is the first game that we have developed as a full-time indie game developers. To a certain extent, the game had an experimental purpose to it. We wanted to test out what kind of game we could develop when we had given it our best for a period of exactly 1 year. Naturally, the game was developed with no grand expectations, but users have given so much more attention to the game than we had expected. We are grateful on one hand and burdened by a feeling of responsibility on the other.

The game development was mainly focused on implementing the core gameplay in a condensed and concise manner. For this reason, the game was intended to be played lightly until a user has won World Championship, after which the game is finished. In view of all the support and interest of our users, we are contemplating of the ways we can increase playtime and improve the game itself.

We are planning on providing free updates until we have fixed all the things that require fixing. You can check out upcoming updates on the roadmap below.

In this regard, we would like add further explanation regarding the NO DLC, NO Discount, etc. policies which were fixed in the previous Announcement as to avoid any misinterpretation. 

In general, we are somewhat reluctant towards Early Access System and paying extra for games' additional contents such as DLC. In case of Early Access, we are reluctant to sell a game which is not complete. In case of DLC, we are reluctant to receive a new payment for the game's value that has already been paid for. Of course, we have no intention of implying that Early Access and DLC are always bad. Our policies came about from where we stand on Early Access and DLC and we would be much appreciative for you understanding.

The first game experience cannot be recreated. The advantage of launching through Early Access is securing funds for further development. However, from the player's point of view, replaying the completed version of the game, only after trying out an unfinished version, is inevitably less fun, than playing the completed version for the first time. We did not provide Early Access because we wanted to release the game at a time when a complete fun experience could be provided.

For this same reason, we feel sorry that the game was indirectly exposed through broadcasting. But as an indie game team we did not have many viable marketing options to choose from. Hence, we ask for you understanding.

No DLC does not mean that the development of Teamfight Manager is over. It means that any additional content or upgrades of the game can be enjoyed without additional payment. No Discount means that the cost of enjoying the game is fixed and in order to enjoy the game users only need to pay the fixed cost. This policy's purpose is to prevent any feelings of loss for the people who have purchased the game at a full price. We want our games to be recognized for their fair value and we will do our best to create games that deserves to be considered in such a manner.

[h2]Donation DLC[/h2]

Although there will be no DLC where users pay extra to get additional contents, we are planning on making Donation DLC available. Purchasing Donation DLC(does not contain any contents) does not affect the game in any way. As its name suggests, Donation DLC is a DLC that you purchase as a donation. When users purchase Donation DLC, it greatly helps our team in its further development of the game. Purchasing Donation DLC does not change the gameplay experience. Since perceived value of the game varies from user to user, our team has decided to set a minimal price for the game but at the same time make Donation DLC available for users who experience a greater value from playing the game. This kind of pricing policy will be applied to all future games developed by Team Samoyed.

[h2]Development Roadmap[/h2]

After the release, we are planning on making updates outlined below. Update order or details may change according to changes in development priorities.

- Additional Champions: We are planning on increasing the number of Champions up to 40.

- Off-season content: alleviate dullness during offseason by making available special trainings for players' growth, acquisition of materials through various activities such as streaming, etc. We are in the process of creating training functions that can be unlocked through facility improvements. Through special trainings players' champion mastery may be adjusted to bring about more desirable outcomes. 

- New game+: Because 2v2 and 3v3 settings, in a way, serve as tutorials, users who have experienced 4v4 may feel boredom when they replay the game from the beginning starting from 2v2 or 3v3 settings. For users who crave for a more challenging replay of the game, we are planning on making 4v4 available from the beginning and adding Ban & Pick time limit, game difficulty, champion configuration options as to allow the game to be played in a way desired by users.

- Interviews and incidents: as to increase immersiveness we are planning on adding game details such as coach interviews, various events  and incidents within a team, etc.

- Trade market: Due to the game's system it may be difficult to implement a complex player trade market that can be seen in other management games such as FM, but we are thinking of ways to implement a limited trade market within the game, where players can be searched and traded as to increase fun of the game.

- Improvement of Stats: planning on making available additional information about individual stats/records, club history, etc.

- Workshop: as much as we would love to provide workshop, the game was not developed with mod in mind. Therefore, it is uncertain how much work workshop would require. Although we would like to promise workshop, it is uncertain at this stage. We will do our best to provide workshop, even if it may be a partial one.

- Convenience Improvement: We are planning on improving details such as marking of special effect application, omitting award ceremony, etc.

We will continue to put in hard work in order to bring to you exceptional games. Thank you.
